about: Copilot CLI 1.0.105 input-box screens for #825, built only from captured screens and cli-main.js rendering code; no live probes.

cases.name: empty-interactive
cases.source: captured live with Copilot CLI 1.0.105 (the repo's LaunchFlowTests.CopilotReady screen: rail box and footer)
rows: ← open sidebar · Interactive · Allow All · / commands · ? help · tab next tab

cases.name: draft-one-line

cases.name: draft-two-lines

cases.name: working-empty
cases.source: the captured empty rail box, under it the turn's row: cli-main.js LMe with its activity indicator, drawn in the footer's place while a turn runs: a spinner frame (rr; the glyph varies) with yut's 'Working', then sm('esc', 'interrupt'), '·' and sm(<enqueue key>, 'enqueue'); no rDo commands or sidebar hint; drawn 80 columns wide (the box's edges span the frame)

cases.name: working-draft
cases.source: as working-empty, with text in the box one column in; drawn 80 columns wide (the box's edges span the frame)

cases.name: working-shell
cases.source: as working-empty in shell mode: the placeholder (W), and Xlt's label 'Shell · Allow All' then '·' (activity) before the spinner; drawn 80 columns wide (the box's edges span the frame)
rows: Shell · Allow All · ◐ Working esc interrupt · ctrl+q enqueue

cases.name: working-vim-normal
cases.source: as working-empty with vim's normal mode first (Zlt: '-- NORMAL --' then '·'); drawn 80 columns wide (the box's edges span the frame)
rows: -- NORMAL -- · ◐ Working esc interrupt · ctrl+q enqueue

cases.name: working-cancelling
cases.source: as working-empty while the turn is cancelled: yut's 'Cancelling', and LMe's activity indicator drops Esc's and the enqueue hints (os === 'cancelling'), leaving nothing the host can tell the turn's row by; drawn 80 columns wide (the box's edges span the frame)

cases.name: working-narrow
cases.source: as working-empty in a window under 80 columns (the box's edges 40 wide): LMe draws the turn's row without Zlt's vim label or Xlt's mode label (Le = Ne && ..., Ne = width < V5.compact), so a whitespace draft in shell mode, drawn as an empty '┃', cannot be told from an empty interactive box
